# `browser-tab apply`

- **Usage**: `browser-tab apply <--plan <id>> [--conflict <mode>]`

Apply a live-layout plan from browser-tab plan (needs daemon + extension)

## Flags

### `--plan <id>`

planId from plan_tab_change (must still be current)

### `--conflict <mode>`

Stale-plan policy: error (default) | replan (same members, budget 1) | best-effort
